episodes.title: Religion Or Radicalization?: How Pastor Mackenzie Built a Death Cult | The Big Picture Podcast EP43
episodes.description:
Following the High Court’s landmark murder conviction of Paul Mackenzie and his co-accused for the deaths of 191 people, Kenya is forced to confront a chilling reality: how did a former taxi driver build a death cult in broad daylight?

Community Organizer & Communications Specialist Ivy Werimba and Clinical Psychologist Francis Kathambana join us in this episode to unpack religious radicalisation. We dissect the court’s findings on cult brainwashing, the fine line where free will ends, how poverty was weaponized to enable religious sycophancy, and whether the state has done enough to rehabilitate survivors.

Catch the episode live at 6PM.
